name: accountingqb
description: 131 AI tools connecting Claude to QuickBooks Online. Reports, reconciliation, tax prep (US Schedule C + Canada GST/HST, T2125), anomaly detection — all through natural conversation.
long_description:
Connect Claude to your QuickBooks Online with one click. Run P&L reports, reconcile transactions, prep for taxes, detect anomalies, and more. Full US and Canada support: Schedule C, quarterly estimates and 1099s for the US; GST/HST returns, T2125, CCA schedules, T4A reporting and CRA instalments for Canada. Your data stays on your machine — zero cloud routing.

**Getting Started:**
1. Enter your license key (get one at accountingqb.com)
2. Click 'Connect QuickBooks' when prompted
3. Start asking Claude about your books!

**Requirements:** Python 3.10 or newer on your machine (all Python package dependencies are bundled with the extension).
